name: unsafe fn set_init (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self
rule: The caller must ensure that the first `n` unfilled bytes of the buffer have already been initialized before calling `set_init`.
api: impl < 'data > core::io::borrowed_buf::BorrowedBuf < 'data > { unsafe fn set_init (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self }
expression: $1.filled + $2 <= len($1.buf) and all([b.$mem.initialized for b in $1.buf if $1.buf.$mem.start + $1.filled <= b.$mem.start < $1.buf.$mem.start + $1.filled + $2])
